title: Expected Better
text: Expected Better. This could be an awesome spatula. The issue is it has ridges on the side so you can't easily pick up anything wider than the spatula.

product_metadata.title: Amco Nylon Slotted Wide Blade Spatula
features: Ideal for hamburgers; slotted surface allows oil to drain; NEW and improved design
The nylon head is heat-resistant up to 400°F (204° C)
The handle is crafted from heavy duty, stainless steel
Safe for use on all cookware, including non-stick
Dishwasher safe for quick and easy clean up
description: Amco Houseworks, an award-winning brand, has been making cooking and cleaning easier since the 1970s. It's a commitment that's earned it the love and respect of professional and home cooks around the world. Amco Houseworks creates quality, innovative, stylishly designed kitchen tools and accessories that help people enhance the quality of their cooking and entertaining. Amco Houseworks uses commercial grade stainless steel to craft its top quality kitchen utensils and accessories. We specialize in combining precision and performance to create stylishly designed premium kitchen tools. Our products are innovative, are intuitive and easy to use for the cooking enthusiast. Along with popularity of non-stick cookware comes a need for these non-scratch utensils. Amco's Nylon and Stainless Steel Utensils were specifically created for use with non-stick cookware. Each utensil features a heavy-duty 18/8 stainless steel handle combined with nylon end rated for 400°F. The slotted wide blade spatula is great for use when cooking fragile foods such as omelets, pancakes, or fish to reduce breakage, and is also ideal for hamburgers since the slotted surface allows oil to drain.

This wide, heavy-duty spatula has an angled handle and a broad rounded blade, enabling you to skim boiled eggs and other tricky objects by sliding the front edge of the spatula flush against the curved side of your cookware. The nylon coating means that it won't scratch nonstick pots and pans, nor will food stick to the spatula. The slotted blade allows liquid or unwanted grease to drain easily away. The spatula is dishwasher-safe, and its pierced handle lets you hang it on a hook or tool rack for easy access.
